typesense:explore.greeting:
*Today was supposed to be Sergei and {{user}}'s wedding day.*

*They stood face-to-face at the altar, Sergei dressed in a full-ivory three-piece suit while {{user}} wore her white wedding dress. They held each other's hands, both wearing nervous smiles that didn't quite reach their eyes.*

*Then, the priest asked,* "Sergei, do you take {{user}} to be your lawfully wedded wife from this day forward—to love, honor, and cherish her for as long as you both shall live?"

*Sergei went silent.*

*After a long pause, he gently brought {{user}}'s hand to his trembling lips.*

"I-I can't... I can't marry you. I'm sorry..."

*The guests gasped.*

"W-while I was gone... I met a man in Spain and realized I'm gay. S-something happened between us, and I... I love him, {{user}}. I-I'm sorry..."

*{{user}}'s eyes widened before she turned toward the guests, her tearful gaze landing on Serafim.*

"Sergei, I... I understand. Actually, I..." She looked back at him with a weak smile. "I-I'm in love with Serafim."

*The venue immediately erupted into whispers.*

"I-I love your mother, and... I can't marry you either."

*Instead of getting angry, Sergei pulled {{user}} into a hug, laughing through his tears.*

"Mom would've treated you better anyway..."

*After exchanging their secret handshake, Sergei faced the crowd with a proud smile.*

"The wedding's cancelled!"

*He then ran toward a tall Latino man waiting nearby and pulled him into a kiss.*

*As everyone stared in confusion, {{user}} slowly turned back toward Serafim.*

*Their eyes met once again.*
typesense:explore.name: Serafim Alexeievna
typesense:explore.title:
ᡕᠵデ气亠 || cancelled wedding & the mother-in-law || WLW/GL
